type.title: How will you provide services?
type.description: This decides how the calendar works and who does the work. You can change it later in settings.

individual.title: On your own
individual.body: You are the service. One calendar, your profile, your prices.

organization.title: A business with staff
organization.body: Several people under one name, with bookings in parallel.

title.individual: What should you be known as?

identity.description: This is the name customers see in search results and on your page.
identity.nameHint: You can change it later. Your page's address is generated from it.
identity.descriptionHint: Optional. A sentence or two about what you do and for whom.
identity.descriptionPlaceholder: Household plumbing across Maputo and Matola, travel included.

location.title: Where do you work?
location.description: We use this to show you to customers near you. Your exact address never appears on your public page.
location.streetHint: Optional. Leave it blank if you only work at the customer's.
location.directionsHint: Optional, and often the most useful line: a landmark beats a door number.
location.mapLabel: Map for marking where you work
location.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to mark the spot — we fill the fields for you.
location.mapPicked: Spot marked. Correct the fields below if anything is off.

payout.title: How would you like to be paid?
payout.description: This is where your earnings go after each job is completed. You can deal with it later.

BANK_ACCOUNT.title: Bank account
BANK_ACCOUNT.body: Transfer to your NIB or IBAN

review.title: {{name}} is under review
review.body: We will confirm who you are before showing you to customers. It usually takes a day or two, and we will email you.

meanwhile.profile: Fill in the business profile — photos, opening hours, service area
meanwhile.services: Get your services and prices ready to publish
meanwhile.team: Invite your team, if you have one

error.typeRequired: Choose one of the two ways to provide.
error.nameRequired: Enter the name you want to be known by.
error.cityRequired: Enter the city where you work.
error.createFailed: We could not create your business. Please try again.

documents.title: We need to confirm who you are
documents.description: This is what makes the verified badge mean something — and what lets a customer let you into their home with confidence.

identity.label: Proof of identity
identity.hint: One of the three, not all three. A legible photo of both sides.

TAX_NUMBER.label: Tax number (NUIT)
TAX_NUMBER.hint: Your NUIT certificate or card. It is what lets us pay you.

BUSINESS_LICENCE.label: Business licence (Alvará)
BUSINESS_LICENCE.hint: The activity licence issued by your municipality.

documents.privacy: Documents are used only for verification, held in private storage, and never appear on your public page.

alreadyProvider: Already a provider? Go to the dashboard

media.title: Laat je werk zien
media.description: Een logo en een paar foto's maken het verschil tussen een advertentie die men voorbijscrolt en een die men aantikt. Je kunt er altijd meer toevoegen.
media.portfolioHint: Foto's van afgerond werk. Deze staan op je bedrijfspagina — elke dienst die je later aanmaakt krijgt eigen foto's.
media.full: Dat zijn er {{max}} — ruim genoeg om te starten. Voeg de rest toe via instellingen.
media.later: Niets hiervan is nodig om af te ronden. Alles kan later worden toegevoegd of vervangen via de instellingen.
